  "pros": [
    "Improved project visibility and real-time status updates across all construction sites.",
    "Streamlined team collaboration and workflow management compared to using spreadsheets.",
    "Enhanced ability to track budgets, resources, and deadlines effectively."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Initial learning curve for the team moving from Excel to a more structured platform.",
    "Cost can be a consideration for a small business compared to free spreadsheet tools.",
    "Reporting features, while good, sometimes require customization for specific executive-level insights."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "The CEO found Smartsheet to be a significant upgrade from Microsoft Excel for managing their construction projects and team collaboration. The platform provided much-needed visibility into project progress and resource allocation, which was crucial for strategic oversight. While there was an initial adaptation period for the team, the benefits in efficiency and streamlined workflows ultimately justified the investment for their small business."
